gaps.sentence: The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.

gaps.sentence: Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: She's taken ___ knitting to relax after work.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby, sport, activity).

gaps.sentence: The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
The ink ___ off after the first wash.
gaps.explanation: 'Come off' = become removed, especially by washing.

gaps.sentence: Her essay stands ___ from the rest of the class.
gaps.explanation: stand out = be easy to notice, be better/different.

gaps.sentence: The doctors pulled him ___ after a difficult night.
gaps.explanation: pull through = recover from a serious illness.

gaps.sentence: A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).
